free_tier.stated: 250 MB data; 500,000 commands per month; 10 GB bandwidth per month; 10,000 commands per second; one database

per_object_cap.stated: 100 MB per record on Free; 10 MB per request

retention.stated: a database on a free account persists while the account is active. An anonymous database created with no account is deleted after 3 days unless claimed

egress.terms: 10 GB bandwidth per month included on Free; pay as you go includes 200 GB then USD 0.03/GB

interface_detail: a body-style REST API that takes the command as a JSON array; the Redis protocol on the same endpoint; a developer API
tooling: redis-cli against the TLS endpoint, or any HTTP client against the REST form; @upstash/redis SDKs
chaining: the cheapest free cache in front of a free Postgres: 100,000 reads a day off the database, if the write path fits 1,000 a day

limits.value: 500,000 commands per month on Free, about 16,600 a day
100 MB per record; 250 MB total data

limits_note: adding a payment method moves every database to paid, and 'an account with a payment method cannot have free databases'

identity_cost.detail: POST upstash.com/start-redis with an Idempotency-Key provisions a database with no account, no email and no card; the database is deleted after 3 days unless claimed in a browser. A permanent free database needs an email

reliability_note: an unclaimed database carries a warning not to store sensitive data because it is not tied to an account; the documented developer API host api.upstash.com did not resolve on 2026-10-22 while the per-database endpoint worked
confidence_note: a database was provisioned anonymously, PING/SET/GET/DBSIZE were run against it, and the 3-day expiry was read from the response. The free-plan limits are a first-party page.

evidence.proved: POST with Idempotency-Key 5f4fd5c1-7624-43b4-bfc9-94192920d977 returned 200, 3239 bytes, in 7.0 s, with endpoint optimal-spaniel-201484.upstash.io, a bearer token, a console URL and 'Expires: 2026-10-25 (3 days from creation)'
body-style REST calls returned PING -> PONG, SET k1 v1 -> OK, GET k1 -> v1, DBSIZE -> 1; each round trip 0.73 to 0.92 s
Free: 250 MB data, 500K monthly commands, 10 GB monthly bandwidth, 10,000 commands/s, 10 MB request, 100 MB record, 1 database, no credit card
curl could not resolve api.upstash.com on 2026-10-22, so the documented developer API host is not reachable from this network even though the per-database endpoint is

price_per_tb_month: USD 0.20 per 100K commands; storage USD 0.25/GB-month beyond the first 1 GB
notes: The 10,000-commands-per-day figure in circulation is the pre-2025-03 plan. 500,000 a month is 16,600 a day, which is a different shape: a burst is fine and a steady 1/second is not.
